title: HighResilience
Comments: The system consists of short, shallow pipelines serving nearby points, whose simplicity allows rapid repair and ensures high resilience, with ease of intervention as the key factor. An investment of approximately €100,000 is required in the well to improve working conditions for the maintenance crew, enhance ventilation, upgrade the wellhead and casing, and to make the space more attractive for visitors. While the municipality could assume the cost, co-owners should also share the expense. Despite these needs, the resource itself functions reliably.
